tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Search or filter the theme catalog. Returns metadata and key colors only, not the full CSS. With an API key, the user's own saved themes (My Themes, id "custom:...") come last with custom: true; their ids work anywhere a theme id does.

tools.name: get_layout
tools.description: Return one layout as a ready-to-use, self-contained document: HTML, theme CSS, and its slot definitions. Call this once the user knows which layout they want, or with ids returned by suggest_deck.

tools.name: get_theme
tools.description: Return one theme in full: its complete CSS and design tokens.

tools.name: get_starter_kit
tools.description: Call this when joining several fetched layouts into one deck file. Requests like "merge these into one file", "bundle it as a deck", or "make it one HTML" mean this tool. Returns the base CSS, assembly rules, spacing tokens, and a viewport snippet for standalone viewing.

tools.name: suggest_deck
tools.description: Compose a deck and return a preview link the user can open in the browser right away. The user sees what the finished deck looks like without a single file being generated. tools.description: Change a template the user already saved. Requires a Pro account; without one the call fails and nothing is changed. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "suggest_deck" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_layouts, get_layout, get_starter_kit · Private data: list_themes, get_layout, get_theme, get_starter_kit, suggest_deck, export_pptx, list_templates, get_template, list_media, add_objects · Public sink: list_media, update_objects · Destructive: remove_objects.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_layouts, get_layout, get_starter_kit · Private data: list_themes, get_layout, get_theme, get_starter_kit, suggest_deck, export_pptx, list_templates, get_template, list_media, add_objects · Public sink: list_media, update_objects · Destructive: remove_objects

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_themes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
